name: Electrical Surge
blurb: Passive:  Kennen's basic attacks  on-attack generate a stack of Electrical Surge, which stacks up to a cap. At max stacks, his next basic attack consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of  Mark of the Storm.

effects.description: Passive: Kennen's basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Electrical Surge, stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack on-attack consumes all stacks to both deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Mark of the Storm on-hit. This damage can critically strike for (140% + 12%) damage.Kennen gains maximum stacks of Electrical Surge upon respawning.
Active: Kennen sends out a surge of electricity that deals magic damage to all nearby enemies afflicted by Mark of the Storm or within Slicing Maelstrom.
An enemy within 775 units with Mark of the Storm or inside Slicing Maelstrom is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

notes:
The empowered basic attack applies bonus  spell damage, while the electrical surge deals  area damage.
Electrical Surge's enhanced attack will be consumed and the bonus damage will not be applied if Kennen is  blinded.
Electrical Surge's enhanced attack cannot be  dodged or  blocked.
Uniquely to Electrical Surge,  on-hit effects triggered by the enchanced attack's cast instance (e.g.  Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury,  Dusk and Dawn's Spellblade) will apply the bonus damage and  Mark of the Storm to targets hit.
This is not the case with any other effects applied  on-hit.
Developer's Note: This is intentional.
The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against  structures and  wards.
